title: 分级 · 四级｜大学事务与学习沟通 · 60 句
description: 选课住宿、资料检索、小组展示、实习与学业申请；按大学英语四级常见应用任务定位的自编练习。

items.zh: 这门课的实践环节与我的必修课冲突，因此我正在申请换组。
items.en: The practical session clashes with a compulsory class, so I am applying to change groups.
answers: The practical session clashes with a compulsory class, so I am applying to change groups.
items.notes: clash with：时间冲突；compulsory：必修的。

items.zh: 选课系统显示已满，但系办公室仍在统计额外需求。
items.en: The registration system shows the course as full, but the department is still assessing additional demand.
answers: The registration system shows the course as full, but the department is still assessing additional demand.
items.notes: show ... as：显示为；assess demand：评估需求。

items.zh: 我已修完先修课，但成绩尚未录入系统。
items.en: I have completed the prerequisite course, although the grade has not yet been entered.
answers: I have completed the prerequisite course, although the grade has not yet been entered.
I have completed the prerequisite course, although the grade hasn't yet been entered.
items.notes: prerequisite：先修要求；现在完成时与被动语态结合。

items.zh: 这门选修课不计入专业要求，却可以计入总学分。
items.en: The elective does not count towards my major requirements, but it contributes to my total credits.
answers: The elective does not count towards my major requirements, but it contributes to my total credits.
The elective doesn't count towards my major requirements, but it contributes to my total credits.
items.notes: count towards：计入；credit：学分。

items.zh: 退课截止日之后，需要额外提交书面理由。
items.en: Withdrawing after the deadline requires an additional written explanation.
answers: Withdrawing after the deadline requires an additional written explanation.
items.notes: withdrawing 作主语；written explanation：书面说明。

items.zh: 研讨课要求提前阅读，而不是到课堂上才第一次接触材料。
items.en: The seminar requires advance reading, rather than a first encounter with the material in class.
answers: The seminar requires advance reading, rather than a first encounter with the material in class.
items.notes: advance reading：预先阅读；encounter：接触。

items.zh: 如果转专业获批，我需要重新核对毕业要求。
items.en: If my change of major is approved, I will need to review the graduation requirements.
answers: If my change of major is approved, I will need to review the graduation requirements.
items.notes: change of major：转专业；if 从句用现在时表将来条件。

items.zh: 导师建议我把课程负担分散到两个学期。
items.en: My adviser recommended spreading the course load over two semesters.
answers: My adviser recommended spreading the course load over two semesters.
items.notes: recommend doing；spread ... over ...：分散到某段时间。

items.zh: 实验课缺席不能仅靠交一份读书报告补上。
items.en: An absence from the laboratory class cannot be made up simply by submitting a reading report.
answers: An absence from the laboratory class cannot be made up simply by submitting a reading report.
An absence from the laboratory class can't be made up simply by submitting a reading report.
items.notes: make up an absence：补上缺课；simply 限定补救方式。

items.zh: 成绩单上的课程名称与招生网页使用的名称不同。
items.en: The course title on my transcript differs from the one used on the admissions website.
answers: The course title on my transcript differs from the one used on the admissions website.
items.notes: transcript：成绩单；the one 替代 title。

items.zh: 自习室实行预约制，但未按时到场的座位会重新开放。
items.en: Study-room seats require reservations, but unused bookings are released if holders fail to arrive on time.
answers: Study-room seats require reservations, but unused bookings are released if holders fail to arrive on time.
items.notes: release a booking：释放预约；if 说明触发条件。

items.zh: 宿舍维修安排在白天，夜班实习的同学可能需要另找休息地点。
items.en: Daytime repairs in the residence hall may require night-shift interns to find somewhere else to rest.
answers: Daytime repairs in the residence hall may require night-shift interns to find somewhere else to rest.
items.notes: require someone to do；night-shift：夜班的。

items.zh: 我们的房间靠近公共厨房，因此需要约定深夜使用时间。
items.en: Our room is beside the shared kitchen, so we need an agreement on late-night use.
answers: Our room is beside the shared kitchen, so we need an agreement on late-night use.
items.notes: an agreement on：关于……的约定。

items.zh: 校外住宿租金较低，但晚课后的交通不太方便。
items.en: Off-campus housing costs less, though transport after evening classes is less convenient.
answers: Off-campus housing costs less, though transport after evening classes is less convenient.
items.notes: off-campus：校外的；though 表示权衡。

items.zh: 阅览区可以轻声讨论，档案查阅室则要求保持安静。
items.en: Quiet discussion is permitted in the reading area, whereas the archive room requires silence.
answers: Quiet discussion is permitted in the reading area, whereas the archive room requires silence.
items.notes: whereas 对照两个空间的规则。

items.zh: 无障碍入口在楼的另一侧，现有指示牌没有说明绕行路线。
items.en: The accessible entrance is on the other side of the building, but the signs omit the route around it.
answers: The accessible entrance is on the other side of the building, but the signs omit the route around it.
items.notes: accessible entrance：无障碍入口；omit：遗漏。

items.zh: 我们希望借用一间带可移动桌椅的教室，以便重新安排座位。
items.en: We would like a room with movable furniture so we can rearrange the seating.
answers: We would like a room with movable furniture so we can rearrange the seating.
items.notes: movable：可移动的；so 引出空间需求的理由。

items.zh: 行李可以暂存到下午，但贵重物品需要自己保管。
items.en: Luggage can be stored until the afternoon, but valuables must remain with their owners.
answers: Luggage can be stored until the afternoon, but valuables must remain with their owners.
items.notes: luggage 不可数；valuables：贵重物品。

items.zh: 校园施工围栏挡住了原来的自行车入口。
items.en: Construction fencing on campus has blocked the original bicycle entrance.
answers: Construction fencing on campus has blocked the original bicycle entrance.
items.notes: construction fencing：施工围栏；现在完成时表示当前影响。

items.zh: 开放学习空间增加后，独立安静房间的需求依然存在。
items.en: Demand for private quiet rooms persists despite the expansion of open study spaces.
answers: Demand for private quiet rooms persists despite the expansion of open study spaces.
items.notes: persist：持续存在；despite 后接名词。

items.zh: 这本书有多个版本，我需要确认老师指定的是哪一版。
items.en: The book has several editions, and I need to identify which one the lecturer assigned.
answers: The book has several editions, and I need to identify which one the lecturer assigned.
items.notes: edition：版本；assign：指定学习材料。

items.zh: 检索时只用一个关键词，可能漏掉采用不同术语的文章。
items.en: Searching with a single keyword may miss articles that use different terminology.
answers: Searching with a single keyword may miss articles that use different terminology.
items.notes: searching 作主语；terminology：术语。

items.zh: 摘要看起来相关，但全文讨论的是另一种人群。
items.en: The abstract seems relevant, yet the full text concerns a different population.
answers: The abstract seems relevant, yet the full text concerns a different population.
items.notes: abstract：摘要；population：研究人群。

items.zh: 我通过参考文献找到了这项观点更早的出处。
items.en: The references led me to an earlier source of the argument.
answers: The references led me to an earlier source of the argument.
items.notes: lead someone to：引导某人找到；source：出处。

items.zh: 数据库允许下载文章供个人学习，但不允许随意公开上传。
items.en: The database permits downloads for personal study, not unrestricted public uploads.
answers: The database permits downloads for personal study, not unrestricted public uploads.
items.notes: permit：允许；unrestricted：不受限制的。

items.zh: 把检索范围限制在文章标题上，能提高相关性，却可能漏掉正文中的重要讨论。
items.en: Limiting a search to article titles can improve relevance but may miss important discussions within the text.
answers: Limiting a search to article titles can improve relevance but may miss important discussions within the text.
items.notes: limit ... to：限制在；relevance：相关性；within the text：正文中。

items.zh: 即使改变了措辞，借用别人的观点也需要注明来源。
items.en: Borrowed ideas need attribution even when their wording has been changed.
answers: Borrowed ideas need attribution even when their wording has been changed.
items.notes: attribution：注明来源；even when 表让步。

items.zh: 这份材料的出版日期比网页上的更新时间早得多。
items.en: The material was published well before the date of the website update.
answers: The material was published well before the date of the website update.
items.notes: well before：早得多；区分出版时间与页面更新时间。

items.zh: 我想申请馆际互借，因为本校没有这本书。
items.en: I would like to request an interlibrary loan because our library lacks the book.
answers: I would like to request an interlibrary loan because our library lacks the book.
items.notes: interlibrary loan：馆际互借；because 说明请求理由。

items.zh: 引用电子书时，我需要使用稳定的章节编号而不是屏幕页码。
items.en: When citing the ebook, I need stable chapter numbers rather than screen-dependent page numbers.
answers: When citing the ebook, I need stable chapter numbers rather than screen-dependent page numbers.
items.notes: when doing：在……时；rather than 区分引用定位方式。

items.zh: 我们把资料整理与幻灯片制作分给了不同成员。
items.en: We assigned source organisation and slide preparation to different members.
answers: We assigned source organisation and slide preparation to different members.
items.notes: assign ... to：把任务分配给某人。

items.zh: 演示过程中应先解释问题，再展示我们设计的工具。
items.en: The presentation should explain the problem before introducing the tool we designed.
answers: The presentation should explain the problem before introducing the tool we designed.
items.notes: before doing：先后顺序；we designed 修饰 tool。

items.zh: 队友补充的例子改变了我们原先的结论。
items.en: An example added by a teammate changed our initial conclusion.
answers: An example added by a teammate changed our initial conclusion.
items.notes: added by 过去分词短语修饰 example。

items.zh: 如果每个人只负责自己的一页，整场展示可能缺少连贯性。
items.en: The presentation may lack coherence if each person focuses only on their own slide.
answers: The presentation may lack coherence if each person focuses only on their own slide.
items.notes: coherence：连贯性；if 说明组织风险。

items.zh: 我们需要练习交接发言，而不只是单独背熟各自的部分。
items.en: We need to rehearse speaker transitions as well as learn our individual sections.
answers: We need to rehearse speaker transitions as well as learn our individual sections.
items.notes: speaker transition：发言交接；as well as：也要。

items.zh: 图片放大后不够清晰，所以我们重新绘制了示意图。
items.en: The enlarged image was unclear, so we redrew the diagram.
answers: The enlarged image was unclear, so we redrew the diagram.
items.notes: enlarged：放大的；redraw：重画。

items.zh: 我负责回答方法方面的问题，另一位成员说明结果。
items.en: I will answer questions about the method, while another member explains the results.
answers: I will answer questions about the method, while another member explains the results.
items.notes: while 对照分工；questions about：有关……的问题。

items.zh: 同伴评价应针对贡献，而不是谁与谁关系更好。
items.en: Peer assessment should concern contribution rather than personal friendships.
answers: Peer assessment should concern contribution rather than personal friendships.
items.notes: peer assessment：同伴评价；rather than 限定评价依据。

items.zh: 我们决定删去一页背景资料，为解释主要发现留出时间。
items.en: We removed a background slide to allow time for explaining the main finding.
answers: We removed a background slide to allow time for explaining the main finding.
items.notes: to allow time for：为了给……留时间。

items.zh: 合作记录能帮助老师了解成品之外的工作过程。
items.en: A collaboration log can help the lecturer understand the work behind the final product.
answers: A collaboration log can help the lecturer understand the work behind the final product.
items.notes: collaboration log：合作记录；behind：背后的。

items.zh: 实习开始前，我想了解哪些任务需要监督人员在场。
items.en: Before the placement begins, I want to know which tasks require a supervisor to be present.
answers: Before the placement begins, I want to know which tasks require a supervisor to be present.
items.notes: placement：实习；require someone to be present：要求某人在场。

items.zh: 我可以接触真实案例，但必须在离开办公室前归还资料。
items.en: I may consult real cases but must return the documents before leaving the office.
answers: I may consult real cases but must return the documents before leaving the office.
items.notes: may 表许可；must 表义务；consult：查阅。

items.zh: 轮岗安排让我看到了同一订单在不同部门如何流转。
items.en: The rotation showed me how one order moves through different departments.
answers: The rotation showed me how one order moves through different departments.
items.notes: rotation：轮岗；how 引导流程说明。

items.zh: 指导老师提醒我，提问之前应先说明已经尝试了什么。
items.en: My mentor advised me to explain what I had already tried before asking a question.
answers: My mentor advised me to explain what I had already tried before asking a question.
items.notes: advise someone to do；had tried 表更早动作。

items.zh: 这项任务与职位描述不同，我需要确认它的目的。
items.en: This assignment differs from the role description, so I need to clarify its purpose.
answers: This assignment differs from the role description, so I need to clarify its purpose.
items.notes: clarify：澄清；purpose：目的。

items.zh: 我记录了每次修改的原因，以便写实习总结时使用。
items.en: I recorded the reason for each revision for use in my placement report.
answers: I recorded the reason for each revision for use in my placement report.
items.notes: for use in：供……使用；revision：修改。

items.zh: 客户的问题超出了我的权限，因此我请同事接手。
items.en: The client's question was beyond my authority, so I asked a colleague to take over.
answers: The client's question was beyond my authority, so I asked a colleague to take over.
items.notes: beyond my authority：超出权限；take over：接手。

items.zh: 实习评价既看任务完成，也看是否及时沟通困难。
items.en: The placement assessment considers task completion and timely communication of difficulties.
answers: The placement assessment considers task completion and timely communication of difficulties.
items.notes: timely：及时的；communication of：对……的说明。

items.zh: 我从观察一次失败的交付中学到了流程衔接的重要性。
items.en: Observing a failed delivery taught me the importance of coordination between stages.
answers: Observing a failed delivery taught me the importance of coordination between stages.
items.notes: 动名词作主语；coordination：协调。

items.zh: 在简历中，我会准确说明自己的参与程度。
items.en: On my CV, I will describe the extent of my involvement accurately.
answers: On my CV, I will describe the extent of my involvement accurately.
items.notes: the extent of：……的程度；involvement：参与。

items.zh: 我希望申请延期，因为主要资料比承诺的时间晚到了。
items.en: I would like to request an extension because the main source material arrived later than promised.
answers: I would like to request an extension because the main source material arrived later than promised.
items.notes: request an extension：申请延期；than promised：比承诺的更晚。

items.zh: 老师的批注指出了问题，但我还不清楚如何缩小题目范围。
items.en: The lecturer's comments identify the problem, but I am unsure how to narrow the topic.
answers: The lecturer's comments identify the problem, but I am unsure how to narrow the topic.
items.notes: narrow a topic：缩小题目范围。

items.zh: 我附上了修改前后的两版，方便你查看思路的变化。
items.en: I have attached both versions so you can see how the argument developed.
answers: I have attached both versions so you can see how the argument developed.
items.notes: how the argument developed：论证如何发展；so 表目的。

items.zh: 奖学金申请需要说明经济情况，但不要求提交无关的家庭细节。
items.en: The scholarship application requires financial information without asking for unrelated family details.
answers: The scholarship application requires financial information without asking for unrelated family details.
items.notes: scholarship：奖学金；unrelated：无关的。

items.zh: 我想确认休学期间是否还能使用图书馆账户。
items.en: I would like to confirm whether library access continues during a suspension of study.
answers: I would like to confirm whether library access continues during a suspension of study.
items.notes: whether：是否；suspension of study：休学。

items.zh: 如果无法参加答疑，我会先把问题按主题发给你。
items.en: If I cannot attend office hours, I will send my questions grouped by topic.
answers: If I cannot attend office hours, I will send my questions grouped by topic.
If I can't attend office hours, I will send my questions grouped by topic.
items.notes: office hours：教师答疑时间；grouped by：按……分组。

items.zh: 我并非要求改变评分，只想理解这条评语所指的问题。
items.en: I am seeking clarification of the comment rather than a change to the grade.
answers: I am seeking clarification of the comment rather than a change to the grade.
items.notes: seek clarification of：寻求澄清；rather than 明确请求范围。

items.zh: 这门课提供录音，但我想知道有无对应的文字稿。
items.en: The course provides recordings, and I would like to know whether transcripts are available.
answers: The course provides recordings, and I would like to know whether transcripts are available.
items.notes: transcript 在此指录音文字稿，与成绩单义项不同。

items.zh: 退还的申请材料里少了一份证明，我会重新提交。
items.en: One certificate was missing from the returned application, so I will resubmit it.
answers: One certificate was missing from the returned application, so I will resubmit it.
items.notes: resubmit：重新提交；it 回指 certificate。

items.zh: 在决定读研之前，我希望先了解研究工作的日常内容。
items.en: Before deciding on postgraduate study, I hope to understand the everyday work of research.
answers: Before deciding on postgraduate study, I hope to understand the everyday work of research.
items.notes: decide on：决定选择；postgraduate study：研究生学习。
